hooks.text: 在30名法师的大逃杀中，同时调动数十万单位抵挡怪潮
hooks.excerpt: Face hundreds of thousands of unrelenting monsters in a battle royale between 30 other mighty magicians.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每张卡都有科技树，经济建筑会解锁新牌并决定后续路线
hooks.excerpt: All cards have their own tech trees, with abilities ranging from summoning buildings, units, or casting spells. More cards are unlocked from summoned economy buildings, so be sure to play your cards right and consider your tech tree route in order to have ferocious monsters, destructive spells and more at your command.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 混搭妖精、秘教与宇宙恐怖信仰，用主副派系构筑多色法术牌组
hooks.excerpt: Sow the seeds of mythical forces as a "Fay Caller", spread demonic dread as a champion of "Occultism", or unleash other cosmic horrors from the other selection of fantastical devotions. Each has their own unique devotion perk, gameplay mechanic and distinct theming. Selecting primary and secondary devotions for multicoloured decks adds further depth and variety to how the battles play out.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
